## Module Overview

### Module summary

This module uses an Integrated Step Selection Analysis (iSSA), which utilizes the movement characteristics to determine habitat selection by comparing the actual used landscape to what landscape was potentially available in the random steps. The iSSA is done at two spatial scales, a jurisdictional model (1/jurisdiction with data) and a global model of all the data across all jurisdictions.

### Events

prepareCovariates - this event combines some of the proportional columns from the extraction process so the model inputs align with the formula.
prepareModelLand - this prepares the raster stack of all the source rasters used in the model, this stack will be used in UD modules downstream
runiSSAmodel - This event generates an iSSA model, the specifics of the model (global/jurisdictional/ or both) are determined by the parameter set up

### Plotting

Write what is plotted.

### Saving

This module saves the iSSA model and the raster stack to a google drive folder for downstream use

### Module outputs

Description of the module outputs (Table \@ref(tab:moduleOutputs-caribouiSSA)).

iSSAmodels - a list of all models that the module created, named by jurisdiction or "global"
iSSAsummaries - a list of simplified summaries for each model created, used for quick model assessment
modelLand - a raster stack of all the rasters used in the extraction process that are then used in the model, this will be needed for downstream UD generation
